# ParticleSystem

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · class

```csharp
public sealed class ParticleSystem
```

Runs particle effects: emits, moves, and draws their particles. The caller drives it, as with a sprite animation player: call [`Update`](#update) each frame, and [`Draw`](#draw) inside a sprite batch's `Begin` and `End`.

## Remarks

A system runs one or more effects, as layers drawn in order: each emission (a burst, or an emitter) emits each effect's particles.

It allocates nothing once running: each effect's particles live in a buffer of its [`ParticleEffect.Capacity`](ParticleEffect.md#capacity), rented from a shared pool when the effect's first particle is emitted and returned when its last one ends, so an idle system holds no particle memory and busy ones reuse the same buffers. Emitters are pooled slots that grow to the most that run at once and are reused from then on.

Particles, emitters, bursts and [`Bounds`](#bounds) are all in the system's space, which is whatever space it's drawn in. Particles that trail behind something moving need nothing special; particles that move with something (a ship's exhaust that turns with the ship) are drawn in `spriteBatch.Begin(transform)` with its transform, with their emitter in its local space.

### CreateEmitter

```csharp

```

Types: [`ParticleEmitter`](ParticleEmitter.md)

Creates an emitter at `position` (in the system's space), which emits until it's stopped or its effects' durations end. Move it by setting its [`ParticleEmitter.Position`](ParticleEmitter.md#position) before each [`Update`](#update).

```csharp

```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md)

Draws the particles into `spriteBatch`, which the caller has begun: each effect in order, its particles oldest first.

```csharp
public void Draw(SpriteBatch spriteBatch, Color color)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

Draws the particles tinted by `color`: [`Color.White`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md#white) leaves them unchanged, and `Color.White * 0.5f` fades the whole system to half opacity.

### ReleaseReserved

```csharp
public void ReleaseReserved()
```

Lets idle particle memory go back to the pool again, after [`Reserve`](#reserve).

### Reserve

```csharp
public void Reserve()
```

Takes the particle memory now, and keeps it while the system is idle until [`ReleaseReserved`](#releasereserved): otherwise it arrives on the first burst, the frame of the first explosion, and goes back when the particles have gone. Call it on a loading screen.

### Update

```csharp
public void Update(TimeSpan elapsed)
```

Advances the particles and emitters by `elapsed`, such as the frame's `Time.Delta`.

### WhenEmptyAsync

```csharp
public Task WhenEmptyAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Completes when there are no particles and no running emitters, or is canceled by `cancellationToken`, as when a scene that stops updating the system leaves.

**Throws `OperationCanceledException`:** The token was canceled.
